$comment: Bump `latest` to the new app.json version every time a new TestFlight build goes out. The app fetches this on launch, compares against its own bundled version, and shows an in-app banner with a 'Open TestFlight' button when behind. `minimum` is the oldest version still supported — if you ever ship a hard-required update, raise this and the banner becomes non-dismissible.
releaseNotes: In-app TestFlight update banner so you'll know when a new build is ready.
